description: This file defines a placeholder worker class for background tasks using Android's WorkManager, intended to act as a stub until concrete implementations are provided.

classes.name: PlaceholderWorker
classes.description: A stub implementation of a worker that delays for a short period, simulating background work and returning success.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the CoroutineWorker's doWork method to simulate background processing with a delay, then returns a success result.
